in_marathi.name: Niranjana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niranjana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Niranjana is a Sanskrit name derived from the words nir (pure) andanjana (unspoiled). It is a name that signifies purity and innocence, evoking images of clear waters untouched by impurities. In Hindu mythology, Niranjana is the name of a river in the Himalayas, and it is also the name of a goddess who is revered for her purifying powers.
